notes.title: 1.0.1 -- Bug Fixes & Removeable Hosts
notes.content:
[b]New Feature[/b]

[u]Removable Hosts[/u]

In the [i]Change Hosts[/i] menu, you can now remove Hosts from your party without replacing them. This lets you venture into the Four Worlds or the Forest with fewer than five Hosts. This feature comes in handy for suicide runs, testing unfamiliar areas, or adding an extra layer of challenge.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SyHKEWd.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bgcHRdf.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Improved AI tracking with additional safeguards to prevent crashes

- Added extra validation checks before running certain scripts
